notes: This manifest is the canonical list of automated suites for Dungeoncrawler.
If the product also has language-native unit tests (e.g., PHPUnit), they can be included as suites here, but the PASS/FAIL contract must remain consistent.

suites.label: Module PHPUnit test suite (functional)
suites.notes: Requires a configured Drupal test environment (SIMPLETEST_BASE_URL, database). Run via tests/run-tests.sh for auto-setup. Currently not required_for_release due to env dependency; promote when CI env is available.

_schema_notes: Suite entries MAY include an optional 'feature_id' field when the suite was added for a specific groomed feature.
feature_id links back to features/<feature_id>/ — the living requirements document.
Suites without feature_id are baseline regression tests.
